name: postlet
description: Cloudflare Worker-hosted email client and AI-agent mail gateway backed by Resend, D1, R2, Zero Trust Access, and Workers AI.

scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply postlet-db --config wrangler.jsonc --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply postlet-db --config wrangler.jsonc --remote
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply postlet-db --config wrangler.jsonc --remote
scripts.deploy:ci: wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply postlet-db --config wrangler.jsonc --remote
